In Search of The Excavation Team (2)

summary: Merrin Rockweaver sends word from the Whelgar's Excavation site after mottled raptors overrun the dig. Her letter tells Tarrel Rockweaver that she survived, while most of the expedition did not.

sections.title: A Message from the Ruins
sections.body: Merrin Rockweaver has a report for you from the ridge above Whelgar's Excavation site. The team was uncovering rare artifacts and massive prehistoric fossils when packs of mottled raptors swept through the dig. Most of the crew died in the attack. Merrin and the other survivors remain cut off from Menethil Harbor.

sections.title: A Bitter Relief
sections.body: At Menethil Harbor, Tarrel Rockweaver learns that his wife survived with at least two companions. Ormer's courage helped them escape, easing Tarrel's fear. The deaths of so many colleagues still weigh on the town and its frontier spirit.

faq.q: What happened to the excavation team in the Wetlands?
faq.answer: Packs of mottled raptors overran the dwarven expedition while it uncovered rare artifacts and massive ancient bones. Most of the diggers were slain, and a handful survived on the bluffs above the site.
Merrin Rockweaver credits Ormer with fighting off the raptors and escorting her and the Prospector to safety on the ridge.
Tarrel Rockweaver is Merrin's husband, waiting in Menethil Harbor. Worried by the silence from the dig site, he sought travelers to learn what had happened to her.

faq.q: Where is the dig site located?
faq.answer: The excavation site lies inland in the Wetlands, east of Menethil Harbor and southwest of Dun Modr.

faq.q: What was the expedition digging for?
faq.answer: The team was digging for rare subterranean artifacts and large prehistoric fossils buried in the marshes under the direction of dwarven prospectors.

faq.q: Are there other survivors beside Merrin?
faq.answer: Yes. Merrin says Ormer and the chief Prospector escaped with her, making three known survivors.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the dangers King Magni's explorers face far from Ironforge. The disaster strikes at dwarven hopes of exploring the past.
As an Alliance traveler, you know wild beasts threaten settlements and work across the Wetlands.
